hooks.command: python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/now.py" hook-context 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "[kit] State injection failed (now.py is missing or errored). Run `python3 tools/doctor.py`; until fixed, read state/NOW.md together with _private/state/NOW.md when it exists. A missing local overlay means unavailable, not no state."}}'
python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/now.py" precompact --runtime claude 2>/dev/null || date "+%FT%T precompact hook failed" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/state/.hook-errors.log"

python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/gate.py" resume 2>>"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/state/.hook-errors.log" || { rc=$?; echo "$(date '+%FT%T') UserPromptSubmit gate resume hook failed (tools/gate.py resume, rc=$rc)" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/state/.hook-errors.log"; }

python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/gate.py" dirty 2>>"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/state/.hook-errors.log" || { rc=$?; echo "$(date '+%FT%T') PostToolUse gate dirty hook failed (tools/gate.py dirty, rc=$rc)" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/state/.hook-errors.log"; }

python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/gate.py" check 2>>"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/state/.hook-errors.log" || { rc=$?; echo "$(date '+%FT%T') Stop gate check hook failed (tools/gate.py check, rc=$rc)" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/state/.hook-errors.log"; }

python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/deliver.py" hook 2>>"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/state/.hook-errors.log" || { rc=$?; echo "$(date '+%FT%T') Stop delivery check hook failed (tools/deliver.py hook, rc=$rc)" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/state/.hook-errors.log"; }
